      How to use this map

      Every dot is one idea from the course. Ideas that build on each other are connected, so you can see where a concept comes from and where it leads.

      • 🔍Explore. Scroll or pinch to zoom, drag to move. More names appear as you zoom in. Dots are colored and numbered by chapter.
      • 📖Click a concept to see what it means, the textbook section that teaches it, and the lecture video at the right moment.
      • ⚡Weak-spot mode: pick a concept you find shaky. A ripple shows every later idea that depends on it, and the list shows what to review first.
      • ▶New here? Press Start here to walk the core accounting cycle step by step.
      • ⌨Keyboard: Tab into the map, use the arrow keys to move, Enter to open, Esc to close. Prefer text? Use the List view.

      All concepts, chapter by chapter

      The same 141 concepts as the map, in the order they build on each other inside each chapter. Each one links to the textbook section that teaches it and to the lecture video at that topic.

      1 Chapter 1: Accounting & the Business Environment

      The Accounting Equation

      Assets = Liabilities + Stockholders' Equity: what a company owns always equals the claims of creditors plus the claims of owners.

      Revenues, Expenses & Dividends

      Double-Entry: Debits = Credits

      Every transaction affects at least two accounts, and total debits (left side) must always equal total credits (right side).

      Earnings per Share (EPS)

      Net income minus preferred dividends, divided by the weighted-average number of common shares outstanding: the profit earned for each common share.
